children: has agreed to buy stakes in French technology startups Doctolib, Genesis AI, Pigment and Entalpic, French newspaper Les Echos reported on Tuesday.

Doctolib had said previously that Nvidia had agreed to buy a  minority stake without specifying the size of the stake or its value, though it said the presence of Nvidia would help it to develop artificial intelligence tools.
Genesis AI, Entalpic and Pigment did not respond immediately to requests for comment.
